title: Senior Python AI Engineer (Generative Image Models) - Remote / USD
description:
### **About the Company**


Our client is a **U.S.\-based 3D design software company** that revolutionized the outdoor living and pool design industry — powering over **2 million projects each year** and trusted by **nearly every major player in the market**.


They’ve been leading their niche for over **20 years**, changing how professionals visualize, sell, and execute outdoor living designs. Now, they’re taking the next leap: building an **AI\-powered layer** that will redefine what’s possible in 3D rendering and visualization.

**This is your chance to join a highly senior, stable team where engineers stay for 8\+ years on average, ship code fast, and work directly with founders — no bureaucracy, no micromanagement, just meaningful, high\-level engineering.**

### **The Role**


We’re looking for a **Senior Python AI Engineer** to join their core team and lead the development of **AI image generation systems**. You’ll build and maintain the backend that powers their next\-generation rendering pipeline — developing, fine\-tuning, and deploying models that turn 3D renders into photorealistic images.


This is a **pure engineering role** — no front\-end, no management. You’ll focus on **code, models, and experimentation** while collaborating directly with a world\-class technical team.

### **️** **What You’ll Do**

* Build and maintain a **Python backend** for AI\-powered image generation.
* Integrate with leading **generative AI APIs** (Diffusion, Transformers, LoRA fine\-tuning).
* Manage **datasets** for fine\-tuning and training image models.
* Own **prompt engineering workflows** and optimization.
* Experiment with **LoRA/DreamBooth** to adapt models to proprietary data.
* Scale infrastructure to handle **thousands of daily render requests**.
* Collaborate directly with senior engineers and founders to iterate and ship fast.

### **Who You Are**

* 5\+ years of experience coding in **Python** for production systems.
* Hands\-on experience with **generative AI frameworks** (Diffusion, Transformers, LoRA, DreamBooth).
* Proven experience **fine\-tuning image models** and building APIs around them.
* Experience using providers like **Hugging Face, Stability AI, Replicate, or Flux**.
* Strong fundamentals in **data pipelines, optimization, and scaling inference workloads**.
* Curious, independent, and genuinely passionate about GenAI and visual systems.
* Clear communicator, comfortable working directly with founders and senior peers.

### **Nice\-to\-Haves**

* Experience in **creative industries**, **VFX**, or **AI\-assisted design**.
* Background in **3D software** (Blender, Unreal, CAD).
* Familiarity with **GPU cloud deployment** (AWS, GCP, Azure).

### **Why You’ll Love It**

* Join a **high\-trust, senior\-only engineering team** (no junior devs, no middle managers).
* Work on **cutting\-edge AI projects** that will shape the future of design visualization.
* Direct access to founders — your ideas will matter and ship fast.
* Long\-term stability: most engineers have been with the company **8\+ years**.
* Competitive compensation in USD and flexible, remote\-friendly setup.
* Tons of autonomy, ownership, and technical freedom — **you’ll own your code and your impact**.

### **Hiring Process**


Fast and founder\-led:


25\-min intro call with the CEO.


30\-min technical deep dive with Backend Architect (review a past project).


45\-min product \& culture interview with the Ops Director. **Offer within days.**

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------



As the Company at the forefront of the creation of the Mobile world, and with more than 60,000 patents to our name, we’ve made it our business to make a mark. Being part of Ericsson empowers you to learn, lead and perform at your best, shaping future technology. Ericsson is an inclusive employer where you are recognized for the skills, talent, and perspective you bring to the team.


Within the Solution Area Cognitive Networks Solutions Software R\&D (SA CNS SW R\&D), we offer the opportunity to collaborate with highly qualified Global teams and to enable success stories for our customers. You will be exposed to groundbreaking technology (5G, ML/AI, Automation and Cloud computing) and support the delivery of multiple Data\-Intensive projects from our customer base and internal requirements. You must have the ability to perform hands\-on Cloud and Data engineering tasks independently coupled with the appropriate testing. Are you ready to write the future with us?  

Come, and be where it begins.

 **About this opportunity:**

  

We’re hiring a Senior AI Engineer to lead development of production\-grade Generative AI on AWS—LLM services, RAG pipelines, and multi\-agent systems. You’ll own lifecycle management for prompts, embeddings, models, policies, and IaC (Terraform), implement safety guardrails and observability, and drive AI governance while collaborating across backend, frontend, DevOps, and product teams. If you enjoy building scalable, secure GenAI platforms and mentoring engineers, this role is for you

 **What you will do:**

  

* Lead design and delivery of production\-grade GenAI applications (LLM services, RAG pipelines, multi\-agent systems) on AWS
* Own the lifecycle management (LCM) for GenAI components: prompts, policies, agent tools, knowledge bases, embeddings, and model versions; define versioning, rollbacks, approvals, and documentation
* Translate business requirements into scalable architectural designs for Generative AI models, frameworks, and solutions
* Implement guardrails, safety layers, and Model Context Protocol integrations for secure, controlled LLM usage
* Build observability for GenAI workloads: structured logging, tracing, telemetry for prompt/response, retrieval quality metrics, and cost and latency dashboards
* Define IaC (Terraform) standards for GenAI stacks
* Drive cross\-functional execution with backend, frontend, DevOps, and product teams
* Define and oversee AI governance, ethical AI use, and compliance with data privacy regulations
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration

 **The skills you bring:**

  

* 5\+ years of AI/ML engineering with 2\+ years specifically in Generative AI and LLM applications
* Expert knowledge of RAG architectures, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch), and embedding strategies
* LLM orchestration frameworks: LangChain/LangGraph/LlamaIndex
* Experience with prompt engineering, tool\-calling, function schemas, and agent design patterns (ReAct, planner\-executor)
* Experience with LLM fine\-tuning techniques, and LLM evaluation methodologies
* Strong proficiency with AWS AI/ML services: Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/Fargate for GenAI workloads
* Solid software engineering skills in Python with experience in production\-grade APIs
* Knowledge of AWS security best practices for AI applications and data governance
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines for GenAI model deployment and version management
**Why join Ericsson?**


At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.


Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Why join Seqoon?** 




  





 Seqoon is redefining ownership and experience across MENA. We began as the region’s \#1
 *Invest\-and\-Experience* 
 platform—empowering people to buy and enjoy shares in luxury second homes through a seamless digital journey. Each property is structured within an LLC, vetted for quality and co\-owners, and managed end\-to\-end through our platform, allowing users to schedule stays, handle payments, and resell their shares effortlessly.
 



  





 Now, we’re taking our technology further.
 



 We’re building
 **Sai** 
 — a groundbreaking
 **AI Sales \& Customer Support Agent** 
 that helps enterprises across MENA reimagine how they engage customers. Powered by
 **advanced LLMs** 
 ,
 **real\-time voice AI** 
 , and
 **intelligent workflow orchestration** 
 , Sai combines natural conversation with deep integration across CRMs, telephony, and data systems to deliver enterprise\-grade automation at scale.
 



  





 If you’re driven by impact, innovation, and the opportunity to build region\-defining AI infrastructure, you’ll feel right at home here.
 



  





  





**Job Description** 




  





 As a
 **Senior AI Engineer** 
 at Seqoon, you’ll lead the design and deployment of the intelligent core powering Sai’s real\-time conversational systems. You’ll architect and implement end\-to\-end AI pipelines that blend speech recognition, natural language understanding, and LLM reasoning to create seamless, human\-like enterprise communication experiences.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on, high\-impact role where you’ll shape product architecture, push technical boundaries, and mentor others while contributing directly to a platform that’s setting new standards in applied AI for business.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Architectural Leadership:** 
 Design and oversee the development of complex AI systems that integrate telephony, real\-time audio streaming, ASR/TTS, LLM orchestration, and dialog management.
* **System Integration:** 
 Lead the integration of multiple AI components (e.g., speech recognition, language understanding, synthesis, and knowledge retrieval) into a cohesive, scalable, and low\-latency platform.
* **Advanced AI/ML Development:** 
 Build, fine\-tune, and optimize large\-scale language models and related ML frameworks. Ensure the models meet production performance and reliability standards.
* **Pipeline Optimization:** 
 Develop strategies to improve end\-to\-end performance—from audio ingestion through model inference to audio playback—ensuring real\-time responsiveness and robustness.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner with product managers, software engineers, and data scientists to translate business needs into technical solutions. Mentor junior engineers and lead code reviews.
* **Research \& Innovation:** 
 Stay at the forefront of AI research, particularly in areas like LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and speech processing. Propose and implement innovations that drive product value.
* **Security \& Compliance:** 
 Ensure the design and implementation of AI systems adhere to best practices in data security, privacy, and regulatory compliance (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2\).
* **Operational Excellence:** 
 Develop strategies for monitoring, logging, and maintaining the health of AI pipelines in production environments. Advocate for automation and CI/CD best practices in model deployment.
* **External API and Cloud Integration:** 
 Work with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and third\-party APIs for telephony and voice processing services. Ensure seamless integration and scaling of external systems.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  




* **Educational Background:** 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.
* **Industry Experience:** 
 Proven track record in AI/ML development, with substantial experience working on large\-scale, production\-grade AI systems—especially in areas such as LLMs, speech processing, and real\-time data pipelines.
* **Technical Proficiency:** 
 Expert in Python and proficient in ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch). Demonstrated experience with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Hugging Face) and expertise in fine\-tuning and deploying large language models.
* **System Architecture:** 
 Deep understanding of end\-to\-end system design, including real\-time audio streaming, telephony integration (e.g., Twilio, SIP), ASR/TTS engines, and dialog management systems.
* **Advanced Techniques:** 
 Strong grasp of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation techniques and familiarity with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS).
* **Cloud \& Infrastructure:** 
 Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and designing scalable, resilient, multi\-tenant architectures.
* **Leadership \& Mentorship:** 
 Proven experience in leading technical teams, mentoring junior engineers, and driving complex projects from concept to production.
* **Communication Skills:** 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Startup Environment:** 
 Experience in a fast\-paced, high\-growth startup environment is highly desirable.



  





 If you're passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI and eager to build systems that redefine the voice communication landscape, we’d love to hear from you. Join Seqoon and help us shape the future of enterprise\-grade AI solutions.

* Support cross\-functional teams in integrating AI models into production systems and validation workflows.
* Mentor team members on ML best practices, model development, and deployment strategies.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of AI/ML infrastructure and methodologies.


**What will help you to fulfill your role**
* You have a strong background in machine learning, AI, or computer science, with hands\-on experience building and deploying ML models.
* You're proficient in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch. Experience with deep learning, computer vision, and transformer models is highly valued.

* Experience with feature engineering from multi\-modal sensor data (camera, lidar, radar).

* Background in computer vision, scene understanding, or perception systems.
* You're comfortable working in a multi\-national team with occasional travel for meetings (e.g., PI Planning, \~1x/month). You value diverse perspectives and enjoy working in a hybrid environment where experimentation and learning are encouraged.

description:
#### **How you will make an impact at Vantis**


At Vantis, we have a clear mission: to measurably improve the care of patients with chronic illnesses. To achieve this, we are developing a holistic healthcare approach that combines medical excellence on site with the advantages of digital solutions. At the heart of our strategy is a **hybrid care concept** that integrates modern general practitioner practices with innovative digital tools.

  

We are looking for a **(Senior) AI\-Engineer (m/f/d)** to design and deliver AI\-powered solutions that directly improve patient outcomes and streamline clinical workflows.


This role bridges **machine learning, product, and engineering**: you’ll work closely with Product Managers to shape concepts into production\-ready solutions and ensure they are accurate, explainable, and privacy\-first. We develop and test our products directly with our medical practices, enabling us to go from idea to live production in just a few weeks.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Engineers to translate product ideas into well\-scoped AI/ML solutions with clear success metrics.
* Design, build, and maintain end\-to\-end AI systems — from data pipelines to models and APIs — optimized for accuracy, performance, and explainability.
* Ensure privacy and security are integral to data handling and model deployment, meeting high standards for handling sensitive health data.
* Define and run evaluations, experiments, and monitoring to measure quality and continuously improve performance and reliability.
* Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders and contribute to building a strong AI culture within the team.

#### **What you need to succeed**

* 2\+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning models in production (e.g., NLP/LLMs, predictive models, or similar).
* Strong fundamentals in machine learning and AI, including Python and common frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face.
* Entrepreneurial passion for translating business goals into working products and prioritizing impact over complexity.
* Familiarity with privacy, security principles, and handling sensitive data; experience in healthcare is a plus but not required.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment, proactively owning projects end to end.
* Good working knowledge of German (min. B2 level) and ability to work from our Munich office on a weekly basis (several days per week).

#### **Why Vantis**

* **Purpose \& Impact:** Shape the healthcare of tomorrow as part of a dynamic, well\-funded startup and help millions of patients with chronic illnesses.
* **Inclusive Team Culture:** Join the Vantis team, where everyone makes a meaningful contribution, communication is transparent and open, and small and big successes are celebrated together — whether at after\-work events or at Oktoberfest.
* **Healthy Balance:** Enjoy fresh snacks in the office, a discounted Wellpass membership, and flexible remote\-work options to maintain a balanced and energized daily routine.
* **Modern Ways of Working:** Experience an efficient workday with a cross\-team understanding of goals and priorities (e.g., through weekly OKR meetings).
* **Personal Development:** In a fast\-growing startup, you’ll have excellent development opportunities, benefit from a steep learning curve, knowledge sharing across departments, and a personalized training budget.
* **Participation in Company Success:** Participate in Vantis’ success and growth through our Virtual Stock Option Program.

#### **Further Information**


You can apply quickly and easily using our online application form.


Got questions about the role?

  

Feel free to reach out to Sophia at \+49 157 92357126 or sophia.riemekasten@vantis\-health.com — she’ll be happy to help.


www.vantis\-health.com


We’re excited to hear from you!

#### **About us**


Bei Vantis stehen wir an vorderster Front der medizinischen Innovation. Mit einem starken Fokus auf Technologie und chronischen Krankheiten arbeiten wir daran, die traditionelle Gesundheitsversorgung radikal zu verbessern.


Wie machen wir das? Durch die Kombination digitaler Behandlungswege und einer maßgeschneiderten, patientenzentrierten Versorgung vor Ort.


Wenn du Lust hast, die Zukunft der Medizin mitzugestalten und Teil eines dynamischen und zukunftsorientierten Teams zu werden, bist du bei uns genau richtig!

**Kertos is the fastest\-growing compliance startup in Europe.**  

  

Following our **€14M Series A**, backed by leading VCs and business angels, we are building the **compliance engine for Europe** – faster, smarter, and more automated than ever.  

With customers like **Enpal, Flink, Personio, and Blacklane**, leading companies trust our AI\-native platform that automates compliance, scales effortlessly, and makes organizations audit\-ready in record time.

**Come shape the future of compliance in Europe with us.**

In this role, you will bring your AI and technical expertise into our Product squads to shape the next generation of compliance automation. Working closely with our AI engineers, developers and designers, you’ll independently plan and drive the foundations and continuous improvements of our agentic AI systems. * **Engineer the agent experience:** As part of the product trio (Product, Design, Tech), you’ll shape how our agents reason, act, and learn.
* **Build with data at the core:** Define success metrics and translate data into product decisions that optimize performance, reliability, and user value.
* **Collaborate beyond the code:** Partner with customers, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure AI and compliance features deliver measurable business impact and real customer value.

* **Proven Product Experience:** You bring deep experience as a Product Manager in **SaaS and B2B software**, driving complex products from concept to scale.
* **AI Visionary:** You have hands\-on experience or a strong passion for **AI** — pairing technical curiosity with the imagination to design agentic workflows that solve real enterprise challenges.
* **Technically fluent:** You’re comfortable discussing **APIs, data pipelines, model integrations, architecture trade\-offs, and evals** with (AI) engineers.
* **Driven by data:** You rely on evidence, not assumptions — leveraging **analytics, A/B testing, customer interviews and experimentation frameworks** to guide decisions and measure success.
* **Clear communicator:** You excel at breaking down complex technical topics for cross\-functional teams and stakeholders

**Bonus points:**  

* Experience in **GRC, information security, or privacy** domains.
* Background in **technical product management** or prior experience as a **developer**.

#### **Why Kertos**

* **You are Kertos:** Don’t like something? Could be done better? You have the freedom to push things forward and contribute to making Kertos a great place to work
* **Unique opportunity:** Join the growing team of one of Europe’s most promising early stages companies and to work directly with our Head of Product Felix
* **European funding in the millions:** The EU has funded our AI research with a total of over 2 million euros
* **Regular Feedback:** We foster an open feedback culture and support your growth with regular 1\-on\-1 meetings
* **Full Flexibility:** Whether at the Berlin office, our Munich HQ or at your home office – we are flexible, and you'll be happy
* **Keep growing:** To boost your professional and personal growth, we provide you with a Personal Development Budget of 1\.500€ per year
* **Cutting Edge Technology:** Leading VCs have invested in our vision to revolutionize how compliance measures are handled sustainably
* **Mental Health:** We've partnered with nilo to prioritize your well\-being, offering personalized mental health support for all employees
* **For Sports Enthusiasts:** We subsidize your Wellpass membership for your physical fitness for a better work\-life balance
* **Steep learning curve:** With us you get full responsibility from day 1, push topics forward independently and thus learn a lot
* **Strong onboarding:**No idea about compliance and its automation? No problem, we'll turn you into an expert and provide you with an onboarding buddy
* **Teamwork Makes the Dream Work:** We are a strong team that supports each other, and we also have a lot of fun together beyond work and across different locations

#### **Sounds like you are the one we’ve been looking for?**


Perfect, let's have a chat! Just send in your CV. We are excited to meet you soon.  

In case you have any questions, feel free to reach out to our People \& Culture team. We're happy to answer all your questions.

Founded in 2021 and backed by investors such as Portage, Redstone, 10x Founders, Seed \+ Speed, and xdeck, we are on a rapid growth trajectory. title: Founding Lead AI Engineer (Remote)
description:
**Working Arrangement: Munich, Germany (Remote \- work from anywhere in Germany)**

### **Shape AI That Powers the Future of Financial Access Across Southeast Asia**


At BJAK, we’re using AI to solve meaningful problems — from fraud detection and risk modeling to hyper\-personalized financial experiences that make insurance and financial services more accessible. We’re looking for a Founding Lead AI Engineer based in Germany to play a pivotal role in building, scaling, and leading the next generation of intelligent systems.


This role blends deep technical expertise with hands\-on leadership, reporting directly to our Head of AI. You’ll write production code, shape strategy, mentor team members, and help grow a lean, world\-class AI engineering team.

### **Why This Role Matters**

* You’ll design and deploy core AI systems that serve millions across the region
* You’ll be the right hand to the Head of AI — driving technical execution and engineering standards
* You’ll lead and mentor junior engineers to elevate team performance and capabilities
* You’ll play a critical role in hiring and scaling a high\-performance AI team

### **What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and ship production\-grade ML models for high\-impact use cases
* Lead model architecture, data pipeline design, and deployment strategies
* Collaborate across product, engineering, and data teams to drive AI initiatives
* Own the end\-to\-end ML lifecycle — from data prep to deployment and monitoring
* Review code, guide projects, and mentor engineers through technical challenges
* Champion experimentation, continuous learning, and AI best practices
* Interview and evaluate candidates, contributing to technical hiring and team building
* Stay ahead of ML advancements — and bring cutting\-edge solutions into production

### **You’ll Thrive Here If You...**

* Lead from the front — you’re hands\-on in code, but always lifting others
* Think like an owner — you don’t wait for permission to solve a problem
* Operate at speed and depth — you make fast, sound decisions that balance trade\-offs
* Push for clarity — even in chaos, you bring structure, direction, and accountability
* Care about what ships — you focus on solving real\-world problems, not just academic ones
* Grow the team, not just the tech — you enjoy mentoring, coaching, and seeing others win
* Adapt fast — priorities shift, ambiguity is the norm, and you navigate both with confidence
* Have a builder’s mindset — fast prototypes, strong opinions, and a hunger to iterate
* Keep learning — you’re constantly leveling up your technical, product, and leadership game

### **Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong proficiency in Python is a must
* 4–6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering with real\-world deployment experience
* Deep familiarity with ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn)
* Solid understanding of the end\-to\-end ML lifecycle: data pipelines, training, validation, monitoring
* Experience working on applied AI problems (e.g., recommendation, fraud, risk, NLP, etc.)
* Track record of technical leadership and mentoring engineers
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Must be based in Germany and open to working remotely with regional teams

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with MLOps tooling (e.g., MLflow, Airflow, Docker, GCP/AWS)
* Familiarity with responsible AI practices (fairness, interpretability, model governance)
* Startup or scale\-up environment experience
* Exposure to building internal tools, reusable ML components, or AI platforms

### **What You’ll Get**

* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Fully remote and flexible work arrangement from anywhere in Germany
* High ownership role with impact visible at a regional scale
* Direct reporting line to Head of AI with exposure to senior leadership
* Opportunity to lead and shape a growing AI engineering team
* Fast\-track career growth and learning opportunities in a high\-speed environment
* Collaborative, flat culture where ideas move fast and great work gets noticed

### **About BJAK**

title: Associate Applied AI Engineer (DACH) - Orbit Program
description:
We're Celonis, the global leader in Process Mining technology and one of the world's fastest\-growing SaaS firms. We believe there is a massive opportunity to unlock productivity by placing data and intelligence at the core of business processes \- and for that, we need you to join us.
   

  

**Location: Madrid for an onboarding period of 2 years and a planned relocation to Munich/Zurich after. Customer base will be in the DACH region, involving travel to meet clients in person.**
**The Team**
 As an Associate Applied AI Engineer, you are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. As a so\-called Value Engineer (VE), you partner with sales and customers to create compelling and innovative technical solutions to critical business problems leveraging cutting edge (AI) capabilities within our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A great VE understands the customer, the technology, and the sales cycle making it what may be the most interesting, challenging, and fulfilling role in Enterprise Software
   

  

 You will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to a community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching \& mentoring.
   

  

**The Role**
 Talented individuals launch their careers in the enterprise software world by joining the Orbit Graduate Program as an Associate Value Engineer.
   

  

 The
 **12\-month program** 
 is a unique experience to fast start your career in the SaaS Industry that highlights hands\-on learning, mentorship, and a team culture where we rely on each other to learn, grow and achieve. The program is designed to develop essential VE skills \& competencies and establish strong lasting relationships allowing you to grow your career at Celonis.
   

  

 Your journey will start with onboarding \& enablement to develop your business and Celonis skills through a combination of hands\-on experience in customer engagements and different pieces of training which cover amongst others the Celonis Process Intelligence, domain knowledge, presentation \& demo skills, discovery \& objection handling as well as value selling.
   

  

**The work you’ll do:**
* Work as part of the Global VE CoE to support the DACH Value Engineering team on customer engagements
* Collaborate with customers to uncover their core business challenges and determine how Celonis Process Intelligence can help them achieve their business objectives and AI Strategy
* Execute proof projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence, frame a quantitative business value and deliver presentations to senior executives to drive investment decisions
* Prototype and develop AI solutions tailored to customer needs, including both traditional machine learning, LLM\-based solutions and orchestration technology
* Drive change management and value realisation and ensure a positive return on investment
* Build strong relationships with our customers by winning their trust through technical, product expertise, and business acumen to act as a trusted advisor
* Collaborate and share customer insights \& feedback with internal Product and Engineering teams to influence and co\-develop (AI) product innovations
* Create re\-usable collateral, best practices \& tools within the Global VE Center of Excellence and feed them back to the regional Value Engineering team
* Travel to the DACH region to meet clients in person to ensure the success of customer engagements


**The qualifications you need:**
 We are looking for people who enjoy solving problems, think outside the box, and are not afraid to make and learn from mistakes. In particular, we seek “builders” who thrive in fast\-paced environments and can rapidly develop solutions and pilots using our platform and AI technologies.
   

  

 You have a bachelors and/or masters degree in (Industrial) Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science / Business Analytics, AI/ML, Mathematics or other related fields, as well as valuable work/internship experience. You’re curious, self\-motivated, enjoy continuous learning, and you want to work in a lively environment characterized by high growth.
   

  

**You are successful as a Value Engineer if you:**
* Have a passion for technology, data and AI and the impact it can have on the world
* Have a hunger to learn new technologies and bring at least basic knowledge or hands\-on experience in SQL and/or Python
* Any exposure to process mining principles and completion of Celonis Rising Star modules would be a welcome indicator of your eagerness to develop in this field
* Are able to think analytically and creatively, especially in applying technology solutions to core business problems
* Are focused on creating and adding value for customers
* Have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to multi\-task, prioritize and execute
* Are able to build relationships with senior management and influence decision\-makers
* Are confident to present to C\-level executives and larger audiences
* Are willing to travel to the DACH region to meet clients in person
* Are an effective communicator and fluent in German and English.


**What Celonis Can Offer You:**
* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the leading, award\-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
* Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
* Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
* Prioritize Your Well\-being: Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well\-being programs.
* Connect and Belong: Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs.
* Make Meaningful Impact: Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
* Collaborate Globally: Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
* Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.


**About Us:**
 Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry\-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. It’s system\-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. Celonis enables its customers to continuously realize significant value across the top, bottom, and green line. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
   

  

 Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
   

  

**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
 At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard \- that's when creativity and innovation happen.
   

  

**Your Privacy:**
 Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
   

  

 By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

 Welcome to
 **AGE — our Agentic Experience Department.** 




  





 We’re building something that still doesn’t exist anywhere else at Holidu: a high\-impact task force where AI innovation meets operational excellence. We’re part
 **AI innovation lab** 
 , part
 **automation powerhouse** 
 , and part
 **strategic consultancy** 
 . Think of us as the
 **special ops of intelligent systems** 
 — we parachute into complex business areas, uncover inefficiencies, and leave behind AI\-driven ecosystems that run themselves.
 



  





 Our mission isn’t just to automate. We’re
 **architecting the intelligence layer** 
 that transforms how Holidu operates — from LLM orchestration and decision\-making agents to adaptive automation frameworks that scale across the company.
 



 You’ll join a senior squad of system thinkers, automation architects, and AI pioneers — the ones who look at a 47\-step process and ask, “Why not autonomous?” The ones who see an LLM and think, “How can this redefine our operating model?”

* Identify high\-value opportunities for automation and AI augmentation across business functions.
* Collaborate with stakeholders at all levels to uncover inefficiencies and design scalable, intelligent solutions.
* Architect agentic workflows that merge systems, data, and decisions seamlessly.
* Lead the implementation of AI\-first strategies that accelerate Holidu’s operational intelligence.



**The Lab** 



* Research, evaluate, and integrate cutting\-edge AI models and frameworks.
* Design and deploy intelligent agents that adapt, learn, and operate with contextual understanding.
* Prototype rapidly — from idea to production\-grade systems — using LLMs, APIs, and workflow automation tools.
* Mentor junior engineers and foster a culture of experimentation and excellence.



**The Impact** 



* Shape the AI architecture that empowers 700\+ colleagues and millions of users.
* Build solutions that scale from 10 to 10 million operations — reliably, securely, and efficiently.
* Deconstruct complex business challenges into intelligent, self\-running systems.
* Redefine what “work” looks like at Holidu — making humans more creative and machines more capable.



**The Collaboration** 



* Partner with leadership and cross\-functional teams — from Sales and Support to Finance and Marketing.
* Translate strategic business goals into technical AI roadmaps.
* Quantify impact: estimate ROI, set automation priorities, and define success metrics.
* Enable teams to build autonomously — by designing frameworks, not just one\-off solutions.

* **Languages:** 
 Python, JavaScript, Go, Bash — whatever gets the job done elegantly.
* **Infrastructure:** 
 Cloud\-native (AWS\-first) with Kubernetes orchestration.
* **Tooling:** 
 You choose — Mac or Windows, CLI or GUI, as long as it works.
* **Scope:** 
 700\+ internal customers, millions of data points, and a company ready to evolve.



  





**Your role in this journey** 




 We’re looking for a
 **Senior AI Engineer** 
 who doesn’t just build automations — you
 **architect intelligence** 
 . You design systems that think, scale, and self\-correct. You know that the beauty of automation isn’t in fewer clicks, but in the elegance of a process that runs itself while you sleep.
 



 You’re the type who gets restless when you see inefficiency, who leads with vision, and who’s comfortable shaping the AI direction of a fast\-scaling tech company. You’re not just following the AI revolution — you’re helping define it.
 



  





**Current state:** 
 Too many humans doing robot work.
 



**Future state:** 
 Humans doing creative, high\-value work; robots handling the rest.
 



**Your mission:** 
 Build the bridge.
 



 Manual work is dead — and you’re here to write its obituary.
 



  





**Your backpack is filled with** 



* A proven track record of delivering AI and automation systems in production.
* Deep experience with LLMs, vector databases, APIs, and workflow orchestration tools (e.g., n8n, Airflow, LangChain, etc.).
* System\-level thinking — from architecture to security to scalability.
* The ability to mentor and inspire others — technical leadership is part of your DNA.
* A pragmatic mindset — you care about elegant, maintainable solutions, not just clever ones.
* The storytelling skills to make complex ideas accessible to non\-technical teams.
* And yes — show us your creations. Whether it’s a personal assistant that runs your day or an enterprise\-grade automation you built at scale, we want to see how you think.



  





**Our adventure includes** 



* **Impact \& Growth** 
 – Shape the technical direction of a leading travel tech scale\-up, working with cutting\-edge AI and influencing solutions used by millions.
* **Leadership \& Learning** 
 – Lead initiatives, mentor future engineers, and grow with a €2,000\+ annual learning budget for courses, conferences, and certifications.
* **Innovation Culture:** 
 Champion new ideas in an AI\-forward company with regular knowledge exchanges.
* **Competitive Package** 
 – Above\-market compensation, 28 vacation days \+ 13 Bavarian holidays, and premium wellness perks.
* **Flexibility** 
 – Hybrid model (2 days Munich office), plus up to 8 weeks/year working from Barcelona, Palma, or other offices.

title: (Senior) AI Automation Engineer (all genders)
description:
Holidu is one of the world’s fastest\-growing vacation rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60\+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k vacation rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.
   

  

 Your future team
   

  

 Welcome to
 **AGE — our Agentic Experience Department.**
 We’re building something that still doesn’t exist anywhere else at Holidu: a high\-impact task force where AI innovation meets operational excellence. We’re part
 **AI innovation lab** 
 , part
 **automation powerhouse** 
 , and part
 **strategic consultancy** 
 . Think of us as the
 **special ops of intelligent systems** 
 — we parachute into complex business areas, uncover inefficiencies, and leave behind AI\-driven ecosystems that run themselves.
   

  

 Our mission isn’t just to automate. We’re
 **architecting the intelligence layer** 
 that transforms how Holidu operates — from LLM orchestration and decision\-making agents to adaptive automation frameworks that scale across the company.
   

  

 You’ll join a senior squad of system thinkers, automation architects, and AI pioneers — the ones who look at a 47\-step process and ask, “Why not autonomous?” The ones who see an LLM and think, “How can this redefine our operating model?”
   

  

**The Hunt**
* Identify high\-value opportunities for automation and AI augmentation across business functions.
* Collaborate with stakeholders at all levels to uncover inefficiencies and design scalable, intelligent solutions.
* Architect agentic workflows that merge systems, data, and decisions seamlessly.
* Lead the implementation of AI\-first strategies that accelerate Holidu’s operational intelligence.


**The Lab**
* Research, evaluate, and integrate cutting\-edge AI models and frameworks.
* Design and deploy intelligent agents that adapt, learn, and operate with contextual understanding.
* Prototype rapidly — from idea to production\-grade systems — using LLMs, APIs, and workflow automation tools.
* Mentor junior engineers and foster a culture of experimentation and excellence.


**The Impact**
* Shape the AI architecture that empowers 700\+ colleagues and millions of users.
* Build solutions that scale from 10 to 10 million operations — reliably, securely, and efficiently.
* Deconstruct complex business challenges into intelligent, self\-running systems.
* Redefine what “work” looks like at Holidu — making humans more creative and machines more capable.


**The Collaboration**
* Partner with leadership and cross\-functional teams — from Sales and Support to Finance and Marketing.
* Translate strategic business goals into technical AI roadmaps.
* Quantify impact: estimate ROI, set automation priorities, and define success metrics.
* Enable teams to build autonomously — by designing frameworks, not just one\-off solutions.


 Our Tech Stack
   

  

* Languages: Python, JavaScript, Go, Bash — whatever gets the job done elegantly.
* Infrastructure: Cloud\-native (AWS\-first) with Kubernetes orchestration.
* Tooling: You choose — Mac or Windows, CLI or GUI, as long as it works.
* Scope: 700\+ internal customers, millions of data points, and a company ready to evolve.


 Your role in this journey
   

  

 We’re looking for a
 **Senior AI Engineer** 
 who doesn’t just build automations — you
 **architect intelligence** 
 . You design systems that think, scale, and self\-correct. You know that the beauty of automation isn’t in fewer clicks, but in the elegance of a process that runs itself while you sleep.
   

  

 You’re the type who gets restless when you see inefficiency, who leads with vision, and who’s comfortable shaping the AI direction of a fast\-scaling tech company. You’re not just following the AI revolution — you’re helping define it.
   

  

**Current state:** 
 Too many humans doing robot work.
   

  

**Future state:** 
 Humans doing creative, high\-value work; robots handling the rest.
   

  

**Your mission:** 
 Build the bridge.
   

  

 Manual work is dead — and you’re here to write its obituary.
   

  

 Your backpack is filled with
   

  

* A proven track record of delivering AI and automation systems in production.
* Deep experience with LLMs, vector databases, APIs, and workflow orchestration tools (e.g., n8n, Airflow, LangChain, etc.).

* The ability to mentor and inspire others — technical leadership is part of your DNA.
* A pragmatic mindset — you care about elegant, maintainable solutions, not just clever ones.
* The storytelling skills to make complex ideas accessible to non\-technical teams.
* And yes — show us your creations. Whether it’s a personal assistant that runs your day or an enterprise\-grade automation you built at scale, we want to see how you think.


 Our adventure includes
   

  

* Impact \& Growth – Shape the technical direction of a leading travel tech scale\-up, working with cutting\-edge AI and influencing solutions used by millions.
* Leadership \& Learning – Lead initiatives, mentor future engineers, and grow with a €2,000\+ annual learning budget for courses, conferences, and certifications.
* Innovation Culture: Champion new ideas in an AI\-forward company with regular knowledge exchanges.
* Competitive Package – Above\-market compensation, 28 vacation days \+ 13 Bavarian holidays, and premium wellness perks.
* Flexibility– Hybrid model (2 days Munich office), plus up to 8 weeks/year working from Barcelona, Palma, or other offices.


 Want to travel with us?

* Something you automated (video, GitHub, or just tell the story)
* Your toolkit (what's in your automation arsenal?)
* Your vision (where is automation heading in 2025\-2027?)
* Your favorite agentic / AI tool and why


**Subject line:** 
 "Manual work is dead \- here's proof"
   

  

**Need a sneak peak?** 
 Check out @lifeatholidu on Instagram. See if you vibe with our chaos.
   

  

 Location
   

  

 Munich, Germany

title: AI Engineer
description:
As an AI Engineer, you will work with the latest cutting\-edge AI technologies and have the opportunity to make independent technical decisions. Your contributions will directly support Railway Functional Design engineers in accelerating the development of Railway Infrastructure Design for our client Deutsche Bahn.
 



  





 If you are passionate about AI, excited to work at the forefront of technology, and want to be part of a team making a tangible impact, we want to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, your motivation and talent are what matter most.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Become part of a team, building a next\-generation platform that helps Mermec Railway Engineers accelerate and improve the development of Railway Infrastructure. As an AI Engineer, you will contribute directly to the development, optimization, and integration of cutting\-edge AI models to build enterprise AI Agents and Applications.
* Designing and fine\-tuning LLM\-based applications, including prompt engineering and performance evaluation. Development of MCP Servers for internal use.
* Implementing RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems and optimizing vector databases for fast information retrieval.
* Integrating AI Agents into a modern web platform using FastAPI.

* Automating and streamlining AI workflows through pipeline development and orchestration tools.



  





**Technical Skills, Qualifications and Professional Experience** 




  




* A degree in computer science, data science, machine learning, or a related field – or equivalent practical experience through projects or prior roles.
* Proficient in Python and familiar with ML/AI frameworks such as PyTorch, HuggingFace, Pandas, LlamaIndex or Langchain.
* Hands\-on experience with LLMs such as GPT, Claude, or open\-source variants, and an understanding of their underlying mechanics.
* Knowledge of prompt engineering, RAG systems, and best practices for model evaluation.
* Experience with backend development using FastAPI or Flask/Django and good to have frontend development knowledge \- JavaScript/React.
* Strong enthusiasm for AI and its potential in software development, with a pragmatic, problem\-solving mindset.
* Fluent in English (B2\+); German language skills are a plus.
* Willingness to work on\-site at least 3 days per week in Munich.
* Valid EU work permit required.
* Direct access to cutting\-edge AI tools and infrastructure.
* 1\+ years of work experience with Large Language Models (LLM) based applications.



  





 We are excited to recieve your applications!!

title: AI-Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
**How You Will Make An Impact At Vantis**
 At Vantis, we have a clear mission: to measurably improve the care of patients with chronic illnesses. To achieve this, we are developing a holistic healthcare approach that combines medical excellence on site with the advantages of digital solutions. At the heart of our strategy is a
 **hybrid care concept** 
 that integrates modern general practitioner practices with innovative digital tools.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **(Senior) AI\-Engineer (m/f/d)** 
 to design and deliver AI\-powered solutions that directly improve patient outcomes and streamline clinical workflows.
   

  

 This role bridges
 **machine learning, product, and engineering** 
 : you’ll work closely with Product Managers to shape concepts into production\-ready solutions and ensure they are accurate, explainable, and privacy\-first. We develop and test our products directly with our medical practices, enabling us to go from idea to live production in just a few weeks.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Engineers to translate product ideas into well\-scoped AI/ML solutions with clear success metrics.
* Design, build, and maintain end\-to\-end AI systems — from data pipelines to models and APIs — optimized for accuracy, performance, and explainability.
* Ensure privacy and security are integral to data handling and model deployment, meeting high standards for handling sensitive health data.
* Define and run evaluations, experiments, and monitoring to measure quality and continuously improve performance and reliability.
* Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders and contribute to building a strong AI culture within the team.


**What You Need To Succeed**
* 2\+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning models in production (e.g., NLP/LLMs, predictive models, or similar).
* Strong fundamentals in machine learning and AI, including Python and common frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face.
* Entrepreneurial passion for translating business goals into working products and prioritizing impact over complexity.
* Familiarity with privacy, security principles, and handling sensitive data; experience in healthcare is a plus but not required.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment, proactively owning projects end to end.
* Good working knowledge of German (min. B2 level) and ability to work from our Munich office on a weekly basis (several days per week).


**Why Vantis**
* Purpose \& Impact: Shape the healthcare of tomorrow as part of a dynamic, well\-funded startup and help millions of patients with chronic illnesses.
* Inclusive Team Culture: Join the Vantis team, where everyone makes a meaningful contribution, communication is transparent and open, and small and big successes are celebrated together — whether at after\-work events or at Oktoberfest.
* Healthy Balance: Enjoy fresh snacks in the office, a discounted Wellpass membership, and flexible remote\-work options to maintain a balanced and energized daily routine.
* Modern Ways of Working: Experience an efficient workday with a cross\-team understanding of goals and priorities (e.g., through weekly OKR meetings).
* Personal Development: In a fast\-growing startup, you’ll have excellent development opportunities, benefit from a steep learning curve, knowledge sharing across departments, and a personalized training budget.
* Participation in Company Success: Participate in Vantis’ success and growth through our Virtual Stock Option Program.


**Further Information**
 You can apply quickly and easily using our online application form.
   

  

 Got questions about the role?
   

  

 Feel free to reach out to Sophia at \+49 157 92357126 or sophia.riemekasten@vantis\-health.com — she’ll be happy to help.
   

  

 www.vantis\-health.com
   

  

 We’re excited to hear from you!
   

  

**About Us**
 Bei Vantis stehen wir an vorderster Front der medizinischen Innovation. Mit einem starken Fokus auf Technologie und chronischen Krankheiten arbeiten wir daran, die traditionelle Gesundheitsversorgung radikal zu verbessern.
   

  

 Wie machen wir das? Durch die Kombination digitaler Behandlungswege und einer maßgeschneiderten, patientenzentrierten Versorgung vor Ort.
   

  

 Wenn du Lust hast, die Zukunft der Medizin mitzugestalten und Teil eines dynamischen und zukunftsorientierten Teams zu werden, bist du bei uns genau richtig!

 **hands\-on Entwickler** 
 und
 **produktgetriebener Denker** 
 .


**Skills to be successful**
* **Tiefes technisches Verständnis** 
 : Du kannst komplexe KI\- und Softwarelösungen eigenständig und End\-to\-End konzipieren, implementieren und skalierbar betreiben. (Tech Stack: Next.js, LiveKit, LangGraph/LangChain, Azure, OpenAI, TypeScript, Python)

 : Du kannst technische Lösungsansätze für anspruchsvolle Probleme entwerfen, bewerten und in tragfähige Architekturen überführen.
* **Produktdenken** 
 : Du denkst nicht nur in Codezeilen, sondern in Nutzerbedürfnissen und Mehrwert.
* **Ownership \& Hands\-on\-Mentalität:** 
 Du arbeitest selbstständig und proaktiv, übernimmst Verantwortung und kommunizierst klar.
* **User Empathy** 
 : Du hast bereits Erfahrung mit Nutzerinterviews und bringst echtes Interesse daran mit, wie Menschen denken und arbeiten.
* **Bonus:** 
 Erfahrung mit Wissensgraphen, Wissensmanagement oder Knowledge Engineering.


**Über uns**
**Omnora ist die führende Plattform für mitarbeitergeneriertes Wissen und KI\-gestütztes Intelligence Management.**
 Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, ihr wertvollstes Kapital – Wissen – sichtbar, sicher und wirksam zu machen. So entstehen Resilienz, Geschwindigkeit und echte Wettbewerbsfähigkeit – gerade in Zeiten des Fachkräftemangels.
   

  

 Wir wachsen profitabel, sind unabhängig von Investoren und handeln mit langfristiger Perspektive. Unsere Lösungen sind in führenden Unternehmen im Einsatz – vom Mittelstand bis zum Großkonzern – und machen dort täglich den Unterschied.
   

  

 Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von Verantwortung, Leistung, Lernfreude und Mut. Wir leben Prinzipien wie Extreme Ownership, Solution Orientation und Exzellenz – nicht auf dem Papier, sondern im Alltag.
   

  

 Bei uns triffst du auf ein hochambitioniertes Team mit klarem Fokus, schnellen Entscheidungswegen und echter Gestaltungskraft. Wir glauben an radikale Klarheit, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und das ständige Streben nach besser.
   

  

**Wenn du Lust auf echte Wirkung, viel Eigenverantwortung und ein Umfeld hast, das dich fordert und fördert, dann bist du bei Omnora genau richtig.**

title: (Senior) AI Engineer (m/f/d) - Verification & Validation

**(m/f/d) in our Verification \& Validation team and help shape the future of autonomous mobility!**
 As the Verification \& Validation team, we ensure that autonomous driving systems are safe, reliable, and ready for the road. We bridge simulation, testing, and real\-world validation through AI\-driven solutions and machine learning models. Our mission is to assess system performance, simulation fidelity, and data quality at scale.
   

  

 We're a diverse group with backgrounds in machine learning, AI research, computer vision, and autonomous systems. We value innovation, collaboration, and the drive to push the boundaries of what's possible in autonomous vehicle validation.
   

  

**What you will do**
**Be an AI engineer!**
* Design, validate, and deploy AI\-driven solutions for assessing autonomous driving systems, including scenario detection, anomaly detection, roadmanship scoring, and predictive analytics.
* Build scalable ML/AI solutions for simulation validation, perception analysis, behavior modeling, and scene understanding.
* Develop models for digital twin generation (vehicle models, 3D environments, sensor models) to support high\-fidelity testing.
* Integrate ML models into cloud\-based analytics pipelines (e.g., AWS SageMaker, Bedrock) for automated evaluation and monitoring.
* Work with multi\-modal sensor data (camera, lidar, radar, GPS) to build robust models that generalize across diverse scenarios.


**Be a researcher!**
* Experiment with cutting\-edge AI techniques (deep learning, transformer models, computer vision, GenAI) to solve novel validation challenges.
* Assess simulation fidelity and realism through AI\-driven analysis of synthetic vs. real\-world data.
* Develop metrics and methods to evaluate model performance, robustness, and scenario coverage.
* Contribute to internal research and share findings through documentation, presentations, and knowledge\-sharing sessions.


**Be a team player!**
* Collaborate closely with V\&V engineers, data scientists, and simulation teams to understand requirements and deliver AI solutions.
* Support cross\-functional teams in integrating AI models into production systems and validation workflows.
* Mentor team members on ML best practices, model development, and deployment strategies.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of AI/ML infrastructure and methodologies.


**What will help you to fulfill your role**
* You have a strong background in machine learning, AI, or computer science, with hands\-on experience building and deploying ML models.
* You're proficient in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch. Experience with deep learning, computer vision, and transformer models is highly valued.
* You have experience with MLOps practices—model training, deployment, monitoring, and CI/CD for ML systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker, Bedrock, or similar) is a plus.
* You understand the full ML lifecycle from problem formulation and data preparation to model evaluation and deployment. You know how to build scalable, production\-ready AI solutions.
* You have a collaborative and innovative mindset, comfortable working with stakeholders to translate business problems into ML solutions.
* You're curious and driven, excited about exploring new AI techniques and applying them to real\-world challenges in autonomous driving.


**Nice to have:**
* Understanding of autonomous driving systems, V\&V processes, or safety\-critical AI applications.
* Experience with simulation platforms (Unity, Unreal, Carla, VTD) or digital twin development.
* Knowledge of safety standards (ISO 26262, ASPICE) or EU regulations for autonomous vehicles.
* Experience with feature engineering from multi\-modal sensor data (camera, lidar, radar).
* Familiarity with GenAI, federated learning, or multi\-agent systems.
* Background in computer vision, scene understanding, or perception systems.
* You're comfortable working in a multi\-national team with occasional travel for meetings (e.g., PI Planning, \~1x/month). You value diverse perspectives and enjoy working in a hybrid environment where experimentation and learning are encouraged.
* Most importantly, you're excited about shaping the AI backbone of autonomous vehicle validation.


 We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds — even if you don't meet every requirement. If you're excited about the role and MOIA's mission, we'd love to hear from you!
   

  

 Our benefits in a nutshell
   

  

* Competitive salary (including bonus)
* Hybrid work setup: Work from home or one of our offices \- you and your team decide how often to meet, blending flexibility with collaboration!
* Flexible working hours and the possibility of flexible work arrangements depending on your needs (parenting, care work, volunteering, etc.)
* Budget and monthly expense allowance for home office setup

* Subsidized fitness club membership or bike leasing
* Learning environment with continuous learning days, job rotation, trainings and workshops, coaching, conferences, books, and language classes
* Mental health support, 1:1 sessions with external professionals and mental unload workshops
* 30 vacation days, sabbatical and unpaid leave option
* Relocation support with service provider (visa, administration, etc.)
* Dog\-friendly offices


 For student \& internship positions, we have an adjusted set of benefits. You can find them here.
   

  

 Be who you are!
   

  

 We are a member of Charta der Vielfalt and are dedicated to actively fostering a workplace that celebrates and promotes diversity in various aspects such as age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or cognitive ability, and ethnicity. At MOIA, we embrace a culture where people are accepted, respected, valued, appreciated, and included.
   

  

 In our commitment to promoting diversity and inclusivity, we regularly provide unconscious bias training to all our employees. Furthermore, we continuously strive to enhance our hiring process by ensuring a diverse hiring panel.
   

  

 Our Future Work model
   

  

 Since we love to collaborate, it is clear to us that we don't want to become a fully remote company, but we also don't need to spend every day of the week in the office to do a great job.
   

  

 Our current hybrid work approach focuses on adapting to different needs, including increased flexibility that works best for the teams and the individuals with as much self\-determination as possible.
   

  

 Get more insights on how we work on our blog to find out more about our hiring process or follow us on Instagram for a look inside MOIA.
   

  

 Who we are
   

  

 At MOIA we're reimagining the future of mobility – safe, autonomous and tailored to the needs of cities and their people. As a tech company with more than 400 employees, we build mobility solutions that truly move cities forward.

 Your application to MOIA

description:
**We help the world run better**  

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. **What you\`ll do**

  

Summary:


We are seeking a (Senior) AI Engineer to drive the development, deployment, and evolution of advanced autonomous AI agent systems. You will serve as the technical and architectural owner within our agile engineering teams, leading code and solution design for agent\-based AI innovation projects. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in LLM Orchestration, Big Data Engineering, Data Science and full\-stack Software Engineering, with a proven ability to deliver real\-world agentic AI solutions. Bring your entrepreneurial spirit to a diverse and innovative team and help shape our next\-generation enterprise AI product landscape.

  

Role:


In this role, you will architect, build, and oversee AgenticAI systems across the full lifecycle—from research/PoC to robust production platforms. You bring strong experience in agent frameworks, orchestration of LLMs and AI services, and deploying scalable AI agents in production environments. Beyond advanced AI modeling skills, you excel at developing large\-scale, distributed data and agent pipelines, enabling interaction, autonomy, and coordination among agents, and integrating AI solutions into business\-critical workflows. You understand MLOps and AIOps practices for agent systems and have the business acumen to translate stakeholder needs into impactful agentic AI flow patterns. As a technical leader, you will guide scrum teams, mentor colleagues, and drive quality under tight deadlines.

  

Responsibilities / Core Tasks:

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of agentic AI services, from PoC to production
* Architect and build agent flows, LLM orchestration, and multi\-agent systems leveraging frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Google\-ADK etc.
* Develop, evaluate, and optimize agent strategies for real\-world business challenges
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify key opportunities for autonomous agent solutions across the organization
* Implement CI/CD, AgentOps pipelines for agent lifecycle management, monitoring, evaluation and continuous improvement using LLMJudge concepts and AgentOps frameworks such as MLFlow 3\.0, LangFuse, etc.
* Own the full lifecycle and operational excellence of deployed agentic AI systems
* Lead, inspire, and mentor junior engineers in the field of agent\-based AI development
* Stay at the forefront of emerging agentic AI frameworks, LLM APIs, and orchestration trends

 **What you bring**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or a closely related domain
* Advanced coding skills in Python (preferred) or Java, with expertise in agentic/LLM frameworks
* Experience with multi\-agent and LLM orchestration toolkits (e.g. LangChain, CrewAI, Haystack, AutoGen, etc.)
* Deep understanding of autonomous systems, agent architectures, and distributed computing for Big Data and AI
* Ability to integrate and scale AI agent services leveraging cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) and containerization (Docker, K8s)
* Strong background in software engineering best practices in agile/scrum settings
* Proficiency with CI/CD, MLOps, AIOps (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, MLFlow, prompt and agent evaluation frameworks)
* Hands\-on experience in developing/serving LLMs and agentic backends (Flask, FastAPI, Django, Quart)
* Stakeholder\-focused mindset; excellent spoken/written English / good German and collaborative spirit
* Experience with SAP AI (e.g. AI Core, AI Business Services, Joule) and Scaled Agile (SAFe) is a plus
* Demonstrated leadership in code ownership, technical direction, and team mentoring
* Curiosity for emerging AI paradigms and technologies

 **Meet your team**

  

SAP Intelligent Enterprise Solutions (IES) department has the purpose to “Deliver and Run the Intelligent Enterprise”. IES is SAP’s technology backbone and most compelling reference customer, and as such, we influence product development and strategy, with our customer experience at heart.


Within IES, our “Artificial Intelligence CoE” team has the purpose to help SAP to transform into a data\-driven intelligent enterprise, by empowering SAP employees to simplify processes, leveraging AI technologies. Our vision is to be an advocate and enabler of best\-in\-class AI within SAP. Our mission is to deliver business value through AI in SAP’s processes and be recognized as AI Thought Leader in the market.


We implement both standard SAP AI and custom built solutions across all LoBs. We are customer zero of SAP standard AI solutions and provide continuous feedback to standard development for product improvement. We provide an AI Platform and Infrastructure to entire SAP AI practitioners for building their own ML solutions in the entire ML lifecycle following MLOps methodology. Furthermore, we build and operate a central chatbot platform based on SAP Conversational AI with the aim to provide capabilities from all lines of business through a single digital assistant. We also build those capabilities (individual chatbots) as well as support other teams in building further ones.


Within our team, we practice a trust\-based working model with emphasis on great collaboration, agility and transparency. We offer a lot of room for creativity and freedom to experiment. Our operating model is based on autonomous/agile team concept (SAFe) and SAP New Work practice where we put people at the center of everything we do.

  



**Bring out your best**  

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\-to\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose\-driven and future\-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.  

  

**We win with inclusion**  

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well\-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.  

  

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e\-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.  

  

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training. **AI Usage in the Recruitment Process**
For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.
Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

* Konzeption und Implementierung: Du konzipierst und implementierst innovative AI\-Lösungen für unterschiedliche Branchen mit starkem Fokus auf Cloud\-Infrastrukturen.

* Teamarbeit und Weiterentwicklung: Du arbeitest gerne gemeinsam im Team beständig an der Weiterentwicklung unserer AI\-Lösungen und bist dabei technologisch stets auf dem neuesten Stand.

* Akademischer Hintergrund: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in der Fachrichtung Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder ein vergleichbares Studium mit relevantem Bezug
* Berufserfahrung: Mindestens zwei Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung mit ausgeprägtem ML\-Hintergrund und Erfahrung in der Erstellung, Bereitstellung und Pflege von ML\-Modellen in der Produktion
* Technische Fähigkeiten: Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Python und den gängigen Machine Learning\-Bibliotheken sowie Erfahrungen mit MLOps\-Tools wie MLflow, KubeFlow o.ä.

* Teamfähigkeit und Innovationsfreude: Spaß an der Arbeit in einem agilen Team, "Out of the box"\-Denken und hohes Interesse daran, sich mit neuen Themen auseinanderzusetzen
* Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch\- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir\-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.
   

  

 Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home\-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1\. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.
